ShortDescription.Value: Track every aircraft currently active in your city.

Publish.LongDescription:
Flight Tracker Radar
Track every aircraft currently active in your city from a single radar interface. Aircraft are automatically classified based on their current behavior, including At Gate, Taxiing, Taking Off, Airborne, Descent, and Landing.
View a live list of every aircraft, including its name, altitude, speed, position, and current flight status. Selecting an aircraft instantly focuses the camera on it, allowing you to follow it anywhere in your city. Select it again to stop following.
The integrated radar provides a real-time overview of aircraft activity across the map, making it easy to monitor airport operations and air traffic at a glance.
The mod's icon can be found in the Universal Mod Menu.
If you enjoy this mod and would like to support future updates, consider supporting me on Ko-fi.
